details:
We need more transparency when it comes to recording in-game. 

Much of our interactions are governed by a lack of privacy, or run under the assumption we are always being recorded. In real life it is alot easier to know if someone is recording (despite Meta Glasses and Zuckerberg's attempts). 

It makes for a weird anti social dissonance when talking to new people, dancing to music with friends or just being worried that a streamer might make you their next joke and overall a hindrance to people's privacy and expressing themselves.

As part of some ongoing trust and safety developments...we should have a cleary visible red recording camera light on nameplate when people are recording, and a different shutter sound fx. 

It wouldn't add restrictions to camera and recording use, as those are pretty useful sometimes! Especially to rude behavior. It puts the onus on players and adds transparency in a world where our privacy is shrinking day by day.

It would merely allow others to consent to being recorded when interacting with someone.

Leveraging EAC to pull a list of processes your computer runs like OBS, discord screen share, etc would eliminate alot of key players here.

I'm not an expert on anti-cheat, but I assume it knows mostly what services or processes my computer is running that could be fed into Vrchat and thereby a social indicator. Assuming this is true, it wouldn't add any extra tax to performance since this is already required. 

I don't think adding world or in game camera restrictions cut to the root of the issue enough.

Some safeguards at the process level would substantially decrease popular platforms like Twitch or Discord being used for harassment or other creepy behavior and let people express themselves.

Yes, people could still use a custom app, external capture, their phone, whatever, to bypass and lull a false sense of security,  but regardless this is the status quo and can only be an improvement on everyone's to make everyone's space a little more comfortable. 

Thank you hope it gets implemented
title: Add indicator of Recording / Screen Share to user profiles for privacy and safety.
